# dsh-pet

Original project: https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet

Version: 0.3.8, pinned source commit `86bc30c83225919434de8396073078dc22e926fd`.

Copyright (c) 2026 PC2005-cloud. Licensed under the MIT License; the complete license is included in `LICENSE`.

Synora code includes 11 unmodified upstream transparent WebM animations. `provenance.json` records each source path, byte count and SHA-256 digest. `upstream-config.jsonc` is the unmodified upstream configuration for attribution and reference. `config.json` is Synora's smaller compatible animation selection.

The Synora adapter displays these videos in the application and maps local work status to animation states. It does not execute the upstream Cordis host, request AI responses for the pet, start an external helper, or download another Electron runtime.

Additional upstream-compatible packs can be imported as JSON/JSONC plus their WebM files. Those packs retain their own license terms.
